tasks.title: Lecture #11
tasks.instruction: Listen to a teacher talking in a history class.
tasks.transcript: When people think of life in Europe hundreds of years ago, they often think of castles built of stone with huge towers, castles with homes of kings, queens and other powerful people. Hundreds of relatives，soldiers and workers also lived there. The kitchen was a very important place in the castle. It was busy all day and every day. A castled kitchen was usually located a good distance away from other castle rooms and buildings. Especially the great hall, a large room, where people gathered for meals and other activities. This was because of the danger of fires. The kitchen staff needed to use fire for cooking, but sometimes kitchen fires accidentally grew out of control and could spread to other parts of the castle. That’s why the kitchen was usually far away. Each kitchen also had a garden, where vegetables were grown. Back then, food could not be frozen or kept in refrigerators like today. Some vegetables could be stored underground but not for long. So most vegetables were picked fresh from the castle garden as they were needed. But of course, a king’s dinner consisted of many other ingredients like bread, meat and fish. To prepare a full meal, many cooks were needed. The castle kitchen employed a whole team of people, some of whom made bread and others prepared desserts or cooked meat dishes. The chef was like a head manager, who was responsible for making sure that the team of assistants did their job right. Although chefs would also be involved in the cooking of some parts of the meal. Their main task was to supervise the whole team.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.B: The training of cooks in castles
options.C: The training of cooks in castles
options.D: The workings of a castle’s kitchen

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这段讲话的主题是什么？ 定位原文： The kitchen was a very important place in the castle. It was busy all day and every day. A castled kitchen was usually located a good distance away from other castle rooms and buildings... Each kitchen also had a garden, where vegetables were grown. ... The castle kitchen employed a whole team of people... The chef was like a head manager... 选项分析： A. Unusual foods served in castles（城堡中供应的不寻常食物）。讲话提到面包、肉、鱼等常见食材，并未强调“不寻常”，所以A选项错误。 B. The training of cooks in castles（城堡中厨师的培训）。基于讲话未讨论厨师如何接受培训，所以B选项错误。 C. The earliest known castle kitchen（已知最早的城堡厨房）。由于讲话没有说明这是“最早”的厨房，所以C选项错误。 D. The workings of a castle’s kitchen（城堡厨房的运作方式）。讲话介绍了厨房的位置、花园、人员分工及主厨职责等，全面围绕厨房运作展开，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What was important about the location of a castle’s kitchen?

options.A: It was connected to the great hall.
options.B: It was below the chefs living area.
options.C: It allowed food to be served hot.
options.D: It protected castle residents from fires.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：城堡厨房的位置有什么重要性？ 定位原文： A castled kitchen was usually located a good distance away from other castle rooms and buildings. Especially the great hall... This was because of the danger of fires. The kitchen staff needed to use fire for cooking, but sometimes kitchen fires accidentally grew out of control and could spread to other parts of the castle. That’s why the kitchen was usually far away. 选项分析： A. It was connected to the great hall（它与大礼堂相连）。讲话明确指出厨房与大礼堂保持相当远的距离，所以A选项错误。 B. It was below the chef’s living area（它位于主厨生活区的下方）。基于讲话未提及主厨生活区的位置，所以B选项错误。 C. It allowed food to be served hot（它使食物能够热着上桌）。讲话未讨论食物温度与厨房位置的关系，所以C选项错误。 D. It protected castle residents from fires（它保护城堡居民免受火灾危害）。讲话明确说明厨房远离其他建筑是为了防止火灾蔓延，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the teacher say about vegetables?

options.B: They were grown in the castle’s garden.
options.C: They were bought from nearby villages.
options.D: They were kept frozen in winter.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：老师对蔬菜有什么说法？ 定位原文： Each kitchen also had a garden, where vegetables were grown. Back then, food could not be frozen or kept in refrigerators like today. Some vegetables could be stored underground but not for long. So most vegetables were picked fresh from the castle garden as they were needed. 选项分析： A. They were expensive（它们很昂贵）。基于讲话未提及蔬菜的价格，所以A选项错误。 B. They were grown in the castle’s garden（它们种植在城堡的花园里）。讲话明确说明每个厨房都有一片花园种植蔬菜，并且大多数蔬菜是现用现摘，因此B选项正确。 C. They were bought from nearby villages（它们从附近的村庄购买）。由于讲话提到蔬菜来自城堡自有的花园，而非购买，所以C选项错误。 D. They were kept frozen in winter（它们在冬天被冷冻保存）。讲话明确指出当时无法像今天这样冷冻或冷藏食物，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the teacher, what was the chef’s main responsibility?

options.C: Baking bread for everyone in the castle
options.D: Presenting the food to the king and queen

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据老师所说，主厨的主要职责是什么？ 定位原文： The chef was like a head manager, who was responsible for making sure that the team of assistants did their job right. Although chefs would also be involved in the cooking of some parts of the meal. Their main task was to supervise the whole team. 选项分析： A. Managing the kitchen workers（管理厨房工作人员）。讲话明确指出主厨像一个总管理者，主要任务是监督整个团队，因此A选项正确。 B. Buying the ingredients for meals（为餐食购买食材）。基于讲话未提及主厨负责采购，所以B选项错误。 C. Baking bread for everyone in the castle（为城堡中的每个人烤面包）。讲话提到有专门的人制作面包，并非主厨的主要职责，所以C选项错误。 D. Presenting the food to the king and queen（向国王和王后呈上食物）。由于讲话未涉及呈递食物的环节，所以D选项错误
